# Idea schema

One folder per idea. The frontmatter is the only hand-written metadata in the repository;
every navigable page is generated from it.

```
ideas/<category>/<slug>/
  idea.md        # REQUIRED — frontmatter is the data, body is the story
  code/          # optional — only after a per-file scrub
  evidence/      # optional — tx hashes, logs, curl output
  assets/        # optional
```

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | slug | kebab-case, unique repo-wide, **identical to the folder name** — it is the public URL |
| `title` | string | Reads like the question a searcher types, not an internal codename |
| `description` | string | 80–200 characters. Becomes the search snippet and the JSON-LD abstract |
| `category` | enum | See [Taxonomy](Taxonomy.md) |
| `outcome` | enum | See below |
| `verdict` | string | One sentence naming the **cause**. Required unless `outcome: active` |
| `confidence` | enum | `high` (measured, evidence present) · `medium` · `low` |
| `effort` | enum | `hours` · `days` · `weeks` · `months` |
| `tags` | list | ≥1 domain, **≥1 mechanic**, exactly 1 stage |
| `lessons` | list | ≥1, each standalone and quotable |
| `source` | enum | Which dig it came from. Outside contributions use `community` |

## Conditional and optional fields

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| `what_would_settle_it` | **Required** when `outcome: inconclusive`. The measurement that would decide it |
| `cost_usd` / `revenue_usd` | A number or `null`. Never prose, never a range, never a remembered figure |
| `started` / `ended` | `YYYY`, `YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`. Absolute dates only |
| `stack` | Free list of technologies |
| `reusable` | Paths inside `code/` that a stranger can lift. Must exist |
| `evidence` | Paths inside `evidence/`. Must exist and be non-empty |
| `related` / `supersedes` | Ids of other ideas. Must resolve |
| `links` | Map of label → `https://` URL. Public URLs only |
| `projects` / `aliases` | Public project IDs (kebab-case) and public former names/search terms |
| `reviewed` | Actual review date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null; never a generated timestamp |

## Outcomes

| Outcome | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `revenue` | Made money from a non-founder payer, verified at the source. |
| `shipped` | Built, deployed, and used by someone — but no verified revenue. |
| `partial` | The core mechanic worked; something specific capped it short of the goal. |
| `failed` | Ran it, and it did not work. We know why. |
| `abandoned` | Stopped before a verdict, by choice. We know why we stopped. |
| `inconclusive` | Genuinely undetermined. We state what measurement would settle it. |
| `active` | Running right now. No verdict yet, by definition. |
| `parked` | Blocked on a named external unblocker, waiting for it. |

`outcome: revenue` additionally requires `revenue_usd > 0` from a verified, non-founder payer.
Without payment evidence, choose the non-revenue outcome supported by observations; do not infer usage.

## The body

Six fixed sections, in order. They are fixed so every page is comparable and so a retrieved
chunk arrives pre-labelled with the question it answers:

1. `## What we tried`
2. `## Why we thought it would work`
3. `## What actually happened`
4. `## Why it worked / why it failed`
5. `## What you would need to change`
6. `## What to reuse`

## What the validator rejects

- A lesson opening with `it`, `this`, `they`, `that` or `there` — answer engines lift lessons out
  of context, so each must name its own subject.
- Prose in `cost_usd` or `revenue_usd`.
- A tag outside the vocabulary (it suggests the nearest match).
- Unfalsifiable marketing language: "up to", "as low as", "industry-standard", "seamless",
  "game-changing", "world-class", "unlimited".
- A missing body section.
- Leftover text from `templates/idea.md`.

Everything above is enforced by [`scripts/validate.mjs`](https://github.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/blob/main/scripts/validate.mjs).
If the contract were prose only, an outside contributor would get a CI failure they had no way
to predict.
